# Stack

Stack is a component of `@kozmos-ds/react` whose docs do not describe it yet.

- **Import:** `import { Stack } from "@kozmos-ds/react";`
- **Group:** Foundations
- **Platforms:** React, SwiftUI and Compose; linked to its Figma component through Code Connect.
- **Storybook:** <https://vodoco.github.io/kozmos-design-system/storybook/?path=/docs/foundations-stack--docs>

## Example

From its `Default` story.

```tsx
import { Box, Stack, ThemeProvider } from "@kozmos-ds/react";

const foregrounds = {
  "bg-primary": "text-primary-foreground",
  "bg-secondary": "text-secondary-foreground",
  "bg-accent": "text-accent-foreground",
};

const BoxItem = ({
  children,
  color = "bg-primary",
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  color?: keyof typeof foregrounds;
}) => (
  <Box className={`p-4 rounded ${foregrounds[color]} ${color}`}>{children}</Box>
);

export function StackExample() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="light">
      <Stack>
        <>
          <BoxItem>Item 1</BoxItem>
          <BoxItem color="bg-secondary">Item 2</BoxItem>
          <BoxItem color="bg-accent">Item 3</BoxItem>
        </>
      </Stack>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## Stack

It forwards its ref to `HTMLDivElement`. Its props are `StackProps`, which extends `BoxProps, VariantProps<typeof stackVariants>`.

- `asChild`: `boolean`, optional.
- `align`: `"end" | "start" | "center" | "baseline" | "stretch" | null`, optional, default `'stretch'`.
- `direction`: `"row" | "column" | "row-reverse" | "column-reverse" | null`, optional, default `'column'`.
- `justify`: `"end" | "start" | "center" | "between" | "around" | null`, optional, default `'start'`.
- `gap`: `0 | 3 | 2 | 1 | 4 | 6 | 8 | null`, optional, default `2`.
- `wrap`: `"wrap" | "nowrap" | "wrap-reverse" | null`, optional, default `'nowrap'`.
- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).
